Maya: uploaded new Figma frames for a "compact runbook" and an alternate suppression pill state. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/alerts-compact-runbook?node-id=12:3 :eyes: Alex: nice. question: should runbook show full content or only metadata (link, owner, last-run)? Full content could be noisy in lists. Sam: agree only metadata in list. maybe an inline preview on hover that pulls a 200-char excerpt cached per alert. Maya: exactly my thinking 1: metadata tile in list + a hover preview snippet. details rail shows full editable content when opened. Tess: copy nit: "Runbook" vs "Playbook" — ops team prefers "Playbook" in public docs. Can we align? also accessibility: the hover preview needs a keyboard-triggered fallback. Alex: thumbs up on playbook. for keyboard we can use a focusable small button with label "Preview playbook" and aria-expanded/controls attributes. e.g. `aria-expanded=\"false\"`, `aria-controls=\"playbook-preview-\"`. Sam: also raise performance concern: hover previews should lazy-load and respect list virtualization. otherwise scrolling will trigger many network requests. cache the preview snippet with 10m TTL. Maya: noted. UX for suppression pill: option A: compact "Snoozed until 3:40pm" pill with an inline ellipsis to view rule; option B: icon-only with tooltip. Which is clearer? Tess: prefer text for discoverability. icon-only hides state from screen reader users unless we add `aria-label`, but text is better. contrast check: current pill text color fails 4.5:1 on dark theme. Alex: technical: add `role=\"status\"` announcements when a snooze is applied so SR users get feedback. Also include toast copy: "Playbook added" vs "Runbook attached" — prefer "Playbook attached". Sam: also suggest a short history row in the details panel showing playbook "last executed" timestamps + who ran it. helps on-call context. Maya: good idea. I'll add a tiny timeline: "Last run: 2026-02-04 11:12 UTC by J. Lee". will mock an empty state when never run. Tess: keyboard focus states: ensure the preview button has 3px high-contrast outline and the pill has focus-visible styles. small CSS snippet: ```css .preview-btn:focus-visible{ outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 2px; } .suppression-pill{ background: #1f2937; color: #ffffff; /* bump for contrast */ } ``` Alex: also consider copy: quick action menu currently labels action "Mute". Ops folks call it "Snooze"; platform docs use "Snooze" consistently. switch to Snooze to avoid confusion. Sam: integration edge: when channel mapping rules exist, the preview should show "Deliver to: #alerts, PD: PagerDuty-service-ops" rather than the abstract rule name. customers get confused by rule names. Maya: will update figma and add an annotation for the delivery-resolved preview. also adding a small "what-if" toggle to simulate alternate routing if you change the channel mapping. Tess: can we add a visible SR announcement when the details rail opens: "Details opened for alert " so screen readers have context? Alex: yes, use an offscreen live region with `aria-live=\"polite\"` to announce. Example: `
Details opened for alert 1234
`. Maya: great. I'll push frames tonight. can we do a quick 30m sync tomorrow 11am to align on copy and a11y checks? Sam: works for me. Tess: added to calendar. @ops-bot could you create the invite and enable recording? ops-bot: Created: "30m design sync 1: Alert playbooks & snooze" Tue 11:00 AM. Recording on.
